title: LRAgent: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on system-level optimizations for KV cache sharing in multi-agent LLM systems to improve memory efficiency and throughput. The evaluation is conducted on standard question-answering benchmarks (HotpotQA and ScienceQA), which do not involve religious, faith-based, or ethical assessments.
